annotations.title: OFAC sanctions screening: crypto wallet or name

description: OFAC sanctions (AML/KYC) screening of a crypto wallet or a person, company, vessel or aircraft name against a dated snapshot of the U.S. Treasury SDN and non-SDN Consolidated lists. Address mode: exact match on OFAC-listed digital currency addresses (BTC, ETH/EVM, USDT, TRX, XMR, LTC, more). Name mode: fuzzy match on names and strong aliases ignoring case, accents, punctuation and word order, scored 0-100. Returns match flag, OFAC uid, type, programs, country, list date. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

address.description: Crypto wallet address (20 to 120 characters) checked for an exact match against OFAC-listed digital currency addresses; EVM 0x, bech32 and CashAddr addresses match case-insensitively (bitcoincash: prefix optional). Mutually exclusive with name.

name.description: Person, company, vessel or aircraft name, 2 to 120 characters, in Latin script; case, accents, punctuation and word order are ignored. Mutually exclusive with address.

threshold.description: Minimum name match score from 70 to 100 (default 85); the score mainly reflects how closely every query word matches a word of the listed name. Name mode only.
